- **Total Purchase Price**: $6,506.9 million (Source: `documents/report.md`)

\[ \text{Portion} = \frac{\text{Goodwill}}{\text{Total Purchase Price}} = \frac{419.5}{6,506.9} \approx 0.0644 \]
